data.title: Tehran warns of nuclear options and infrastructure strikes if US attacks Iran | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: Tehran aims to cause even more pain in the case of a renewed campaign, especially at a time when interceptor missile stockpiles are under pressure in Israel and in US-aligned nations in the Gulf.
